description: Lights arriving after a lot loads, at night: the camera jumps across 10 far lots and holds still 10 s at each, twice round, and the window is recorded (-Grab). flash_scan's settle.csv counts per jump the light changes while the camera is still and when they stopped. Off (the game alone) against on. Run with -Grab, without -Profiler; the save loads at 21:14 and the run ends before dawn.
